arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي عِيدِ الْفِطْرِ وَ الْجُمُعَةِ
english_title: 46. On the Day of Fast-Breaking and on Friday

phrases.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَرْحَمُ مَنْ لا يَرْحَمُهُ الْعِبَادُ.
phrases.english: 1.O He who has mercy upon him toward whom the servants show no mercy!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ مَنْ لا تَقْبَلُهُ الْبِلاَدُ.
phrases.english: 2.O He who accepts him whom the cities will not accept!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَن لاَ يَحْتَقِرُ أَهْلَ الْحَاجَةِ إلَيْهِ.
phrases.english: 3.O He who looks not down upon those who have need of Him!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُخَيِّبُ المَلِحِّيْنَ عَلَيْـهِ،
phrases.english: 4.O He who disappoints not those who implore Him!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَجْبَهُ بِالرَّدِّ أَهْلَ الدَّالَّةِ عَليهِ،
phrases.english: 5.O He who slaps not the brow of the people of boldness toward Him with rejection!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَجْتَبِي صَغِيرَ مَايُتْحَفُ بِهِ،
phrases.english: 6.O He who collects the little that is given to Him

phrases.arabic: وَيَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا يُعْمَلُ لَهُ.
phrases.english: 7.and shows gratitude for the paltry that is done for Him!

phrases.arabic: وَيَامَنْ يَشْكُرُ عَلَى الْقَلِيْلِ، وَيُجَازيْ بِالْجَلِيلِ،
phrases.english: 8.O He who shows gratitude for the small and rewards with the great!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَدْنُو إلَى مَنْ دَنا مِنْهُ
phrases.english: 9.O He who comes close to him who comes close to Him!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَدعُو إلَى نَفْسِهِ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ عَنْهُ،
phrases.english: 10.O He who invites to Himself him who turns his back on Him!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُغَيِّرُ النِّعْمَةَ، وَلا يُبَادِرُ بِالنَّقِمَةِ،
phrases.english: 11.O He who changes not favour and rushes not to vengeance!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُثْمِرُ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّى يُنْمِيَهَا،
phrases.english: 12.O He who causes the good deed to bear fruit so that He may make it grow,

phrases.arabic: وَيَتَجَاوَزُ  عَنِ السَّيِّئَةِ حَتَّى يُعَفِّيَهَا.
phrases.english: 13.and overlooks the evil deed so that He may efface it!

phrases.arabic: انْصَرَفَتِ الآمَالُ دُونَ مَدى كَرَمِكَ بِالحَاجَاتِ
phrases.english: 14.Hopes turn back with needs fulfilled short of the extent of Your generosity,

phrases.arabic: وَامْتَلاَتْ بِفَيْضِ جُودِكَ أَوْعِيَةُ الطَّلِبات،
phrases.english: 15.the cups of requests fill up with the overflow of Your munificence,

phrases.arabic: وَتَفَسَّخَتْ دُونَ بُلُوغِ نَعْتِـكَ الصِّفَاتُ،
phrases.english: 16.and attributes fall apart without reaching Your description.

phrases.arabic: فَلَكَ الْعُلُوُّ الأعْلَى فَوْقَ كُلِّ عَال،
phrases.english: 17.For to You belongs the highest highness above everything high,

phrases.arabic: وَالْجَلاَلُ الأمْجَدُ فَوْقَ كُلِّ جَلاَل،
phrases.english: 18.and the most glorious majesty beyond every majesty!

phrases.arabic: كُلُّ جَلِيْل عِنْدَكَ صَغِيرٌ،
phrases.english: 19.Everything majestic before You is small,

phrases.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَرِيف فِي جَنْبِ شَرَفِكَ حَقِيرٌ،
phrases.english: 20.everything eminent beside Your eminence vile!

phrases.arabic: خَابَ الْوَافِدُونَ عَلَى غَيْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 21.Those who reach other than You are disappointed,

phrases.arabic: وَخَسِرَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ إلاَّ لَكَ، وَضَاعَ الْمُلِمُّونَ  إلاّ بِكَ،
phrases.english: 22.those who present themselves to other than You have lost, those who stay with other than You have perished,

phrases.arabic: وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُـونَ إلاَّ مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ،
phrases.english: 23.and those who retreat - except those who retreat to Your bounty - are desolate!

phrases.arabic: بَابُكَ مَفْتُوحٌ لِلرَّاغِبِينَ، وَجُودُكَ مُبَاحٌ لِلسَّائِلِينَ،
phrases.english: 24.Your door is open to the beseechers, Your munificence free to the askers,

phrases.arabic: وَإغاثَتُكَ قَرِيبَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغِيْثِينَ،
phrases.english: 25.Your help near to the help-seekers!

phrases.arabic: لاَ يَخِيبُ مِنْـكَ الآمِلُونَ، وَلاَ يَيْأَسُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ،
phrases.english: 26.The expectant are not disappointed by You, those who present themselves despair not of Your bestowal,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَشْقَى بِنَقْمَتِكَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ.
phrases.english: 27.the forgiveness-seekers become not wretched through Your vengeance!

phrases.arabic: رِزْقُكَ مَبْسُوطٌ لِمَنْ عَصَاكَ،
phrases.english: 28.Your provision is spread among those who disobey You,

phrases.arabic: وَحِلْمُكَ مُعْتَـرِضٌ لِمَنْ نَاوَاكَ،
phrases.english: 29.Your clemency presents itself to those hostile toward You,

phrases.arabic: عَادَتُكَ الإحْسَـانُ إلَى الْمُسِيئينَ،
phrases.english: 30.Your habit is beneficence toward the evildoers,

phrases.arabic: وَسُنَّتُـكَ الإبْقَاءُ عَلَى الْمُعْتَدِينَ
phrases.english: 31.and Your wont is to spare the transgressors,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لَقَدْ غَرَّتْهُمْ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ،
phrases.english: 32.so much so that Your lack of haste deludes them from returning,

phrases.arabic: وَصَدَّهُمْ إمْهَالُكَ عَن النُّزُوعِ.
phrases.english: 33.and Your disregard bars them from desisting!

phrases.arabic: وَإنَّمَا تَأَنَّيْتَ بهمْ لِيَفِيئُوا إلَى أَمْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 34.You actest without haste toward them so that they will come back to Your command

phrases.arabic: وَأَمْهَلْتَهُمْ ثِقَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِكَ،
phrases.english: 35.and You disregardest them confident in the permanence of Your kingdom,

phrases.arabic: فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِهَا،
phrases.english: 36.so You sealest him who is worthy of it with felicity,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ خَذَلْتَهُ لَهَا،
phrases.english: 37.and You abandonest him who is worthy of it to wretchedness!

phrases.arabic: كُلُّهُمْ صَائِرُونَ إلَى حُكْمِكَ وَأُمُورُهُمْ آئِلَةٌ إلَى أَمْـرِكَ،
phrases.english: 38.All of them come home to Your decree, their affairs revert to Your command;

phrases.arabic: لَمْ يَهِنْ عَلَى طُـولِ مُـدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُـكَ
phrases.english: 39.Your authority grows not feeble through their drawn out term,

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ يَـدْحَضْ لِتَـرْكِ مُعَاجَلَتِهِمْ بُرْهَانُكَ.
phrases.english: 40.Your proof is not refuted by the failure to hurry after them.

phrases.arabic: حُجَّتُكَ قَائِمَةٌ لاَ تُدْحَضُ،
phrases.english: 41.Your argument is established, never refuted,

phrases.arabic: وَسُلْطَانُكَ ثَابِتٌ لا يَزُولُ،
phrases.english: 42.Your authority fixed, never removed.

phrases.arabic: فَالْوَيْلُ الدَّائِمُ لِمَنْ جَنَحَ عَنْكَ،
phrases.english: 43.Permanent woe belongs to him who inclines away from You,

phrases.arabic: وَالْخَيْبَةُ الْخَاذِلَةُ لِمَنْ  خَابَ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 44.forsaking disappointment to him who is disappointed by You,

phrases.arabic: وَالشَّقاءُ الاشْقَى لِمَنِ اغْتَرَّ بِكَ.
phrases.english: 45.and the most wretched wretchedness to him who is deluded about You!

phrases.arabic: مَا أكْثَرَ تَصَرُّفَهُ فِي عَذَابِكَ،
phrases.english: 46.How much he will move about in Your chastisement!

phrases.arabic: وَمَا أَطْوَلَ تَرَدُّدَهُ فِيْ عِقَابِكَ،
phrases.english: 47.How long he will frequent Your punishment!

phrases.arabic: وَمَا أَبْعَدَ غَايَتَهُ مِنَ الْفَرَجِ،
phrases.english: 48.How far his utmost end from relief!

phrases.arabic: وَمَا أَقْنَطَهُ مِنْ سُهُولَةِ الْمَخْرَجِ
phrases.english: 49.How he will despair of an easy exit!

phrases.arabic: عَدْلاً مِنْ قَضَائِكَ  لاَ تَجُورُ فِيهِ،
phrases.english: 50.[All of this] as justice from Your decree (Thou art not unjust in it!),

phrases.arabic: وَإنْصَافاً مِنْ حُكْمِكَ لاَ تَحِيفُ عَلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: 51.and equity from Your judgement (Thou dost not act wrongfully against him!).

phrases.arabic: فَقَدْ ظَاهَرْتَ الْحُجَجَ، وَأَبْلَيْتَ الاعْذَارَ،
phrases.english: 52.You supported the arguments, tested the excuses,

phrases.arabic: وَقَـدْ تَقَدَّمْتَ بِـالْوَعِيْـدِ وَتَلَطَّفْتَ فِي التَّرْغِيْبِ،
phrases.english: 53.began with threats, showed gentleness with encouragement,

phrases.arabic: وَضَرَبْتَ الامْثَالَ، وَأَطَلْتَ الاِمْهَالَ،
phrases.english: 54.struck similitudes, made long the respite,

phrases.arabic: وَأَخَّرْتَ وَأَنْتَ مُسْتَطِيعٌ لِلْمُعَاجَلَةِ،
phrases.english: 55.delayed, while You art able to hurry,

phrases.arabic: وَتَأَنَّيْتَ وَأَنْتَ مَليءٌ بِالْمُبَادَرَةِ،
phrases.english: 56.and acted without haste, while You art full of quick accomplishment!

phrases.arabic: لَمْ تَكُنْ أَنَاتُكَ عَجْزاً، وَلا إمْهَالُكَ وَهْناً،
phrases.english: 57.Not because of incapacity is Your slowness, feebleness Your giving respite,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ إمْسَاكُكَ غَفْلَةً، وَلاَ انْتِظَارُكَ مُدَارَاةً،
phrases.english: 58.heedlessness Your showing restraint, dissemblance Your waiting!

phrases.arabic: بَلْ لِتَكُونَ حُجَّتُكَ أَبْلَغَ، وَكَرَمُكَ أكمَلَ،
phrases.english: 59.But that Your argument be more conclusive, Your generosity more perfect,

phrases.arabic: وَإحْسَانُكَ أَوْفَى وَنِعْمَتُكَ أَتَمَّ،
phrases.english: 60.Your beneficence more exhaustive, Your favour more complete!

phrases.arabic: كُلُّ ذلِكَ كَانَ وَلَمْ تَزَلْ، وَهُوَ كائِنٌ وَلاَ تَزَالُ ،
phrases.english: 61.All of this has been and always was, is and ever will be.

phrases.arabic: حُجَّتُكَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ توصَفَ بِكُلِّهَا،
phrases.english: 62.Your argument is greater than that its totality be described,

phrases.arabic: وَمَجْدُكَ أَرْفَـعُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحَدَّ بِكُنْهِهِ،
phrases.english: 63.Your glory more elevated than that it be limited in its core,

phrases.arabic: وَنِعْمَتُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ  تُحْصَى بِأَسْرِهَا،
phrases.english: 64.Your favour more abundant than that its entirety be counted,

phrases.arabic: وَإحْسَانُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُشْكَرَ عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ،
phrases.english: 65.Your beneficence more abundant than that thanks be given for its least amount!

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ عَنْ تَحْمِيدِكَ،
phrases.english: 66.Speechlessness has made me fall short of praising You,

phrases.arabic: وَفَهَّهَنِي الإمْسَاكُ عَنْ تَمْجيدِكَ،
phrases.english: 67.restraint has made me powerless to glorify You,

phrases.arabic: وَقُصَارَايَ الإقْرَارُ بِالْحُسُورِ
phrases.english: 68.and the most I can do is admit to inability,

phrases.arabic: لاَ رَغْبَةً ـ يا إلهِي ـ بَلْ عَجْزاً،
phrases.english: 69.not out of desire, my God, but out of incapacity.

phrases.arabic: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا أَؤُمُّكَ بِالْوِفَادَةِ، وَأَسأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الرِّفَادَةِ،
phrases.english: 70.So here I am: I repair to You by coming forward, and I ask from You good support

phrases.arabic: فَصلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاسْمَعْ نَجْوَايَ،
phrases.english: 71.So bless Muhammad and his Household, hear my whispered words,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِي وَلاَ تَخْتِمْ يَوْمِيَ بِخَيْبَتِي،
phrases.english: 72.grant my supplication, seal not my day with disappointment,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ فِي مَسْأَلَتِي،
phrases.english: 73.slap not my brow by rejecting my request,

phrases.arabic: وَأكْرِمْ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُنْصَرَفِي وَإلَيْكَ مُنْقَلَبِي،
phrases.english: 74.and make noble my coming from You and my going back to You!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ غَيْرُ ضَائِق بِمَا تُرِيْدُ  وَلاَ عَاجِزٍ عَمَّا تُسْأَلُ،
phrases.english: 75.Surely You art not constrained by what You desirest, nor incapable of what You art asked!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيْرٌ،
phrases.english: 76.You art powerful over everything,

phrases.arabic: وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلاَّ بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
phrases.english: 77.and there is no force and no strength save in God, the All-high, the All-mighty!
